# EZ Finish Auto

> Mobile car detailing business based in Brampton, Ontario, Canada, serving Brampton and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). The car stays where it is parked — at home, at work, or anywhere else — and the detailing comes to it.

## Services and pricing (CAD, starting prices)

- Sedans — from $90: interior deep cleaning, exterior wash and detail, wheels and tires, vacuum and steam cleaning
- SUVs — from $125: interior wipe down, interior deep cleaning, exterior wash and detail, wheels and tires
- Vans and trucks — from $155: full interior and exterior packages, interior deep cleaning, exterior wash and detail, wheels and tires

## Service area

Brampton, Ontario and the Greater Toronto Area.
